additionalInfo.description: After a Rugix job succeeded: read system info, apps and components from Rugix Admin (RPC) and store them as attributes / telemetry of the device. Called by a Rule Chain node from the device rule chain (relation Post telemetry).
Fires when a Rugix job finished successfully (jobEvent telemetry of the SSE connector)
Same scope as the attributes of the gateway connector
